status: draft; concrete data/storyboard not yet approved
mainAxis: fixed linear, zero baseline; ceiling rounded upward to 50000
spotlightAxis: separate scale, explicitly labelled DETAIL SCALE
counterPolicy: Bar lengths and ~ animated counters interpolate continuously through every race and narrative segment; exact published quarter-end totals remain separate. Labels hide only briefly where ranks cross.
claims: Compute leadership, comparisons and records only from complete accepted observations. Never predeclare a winner.
motionPolicy: Race and narrative time form one continuous quarter transition; narrative is an overlay, never a chart hold or layout shrink.
